description:
Fluent JUnit 5 test helpers over opentmf-mockserver: starts an in-process MockServer,
    registers Dynamic* TMF callbacks, mints JWTs against the built-in Keycloak mock, and
    redirects Spring api-clients and JWKS URLs at the mock. JUnit and Spring types are on
    provided/optional scope so the module works for plain-JUnit and Spring consumers alike
    without dragging Spring into non-Spring builds.
